title: Launch wave choreography and verification runway for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Define and execute a deterministic launch choreography for the API, Console, and Runtime components that minimizes cross-team misalignment, ensures release-note consistency, and provides measurable go/no-go gates for staggered regional rollouts. This ticket owns the launch-wave schedule, the verification runway (smoke/e2e/slo checks), and the release-notes coordination matrix between Product, Eng, and Design.
acceptance_criteria: Wave schedule with dates and owners published to the Launch Confluence page
Verification checklist (smoke, sdk-integration, performance, security) validated against prod-like environment
Cut gates defined with quantitative thresholds and automated dashboard signals
Release-notes draft for API, Console, and Runtime reviewed by PM/Eng/Design and merged to /releases/changelog before GA
Comms runway (blog, changelog entry, support KB, customer emails) scheduled with publishing owners and embargo windows
updates: 2026-03-10 — Kickoff: alignment session with ENG/Design/Support. Agreed to a three-wave rollout (Internal Canary, Beta, GA). Assigned owners for each wave.
2026-03-11 — Trade-off: we deferred a non-critical console UX tweak (DES-4412) from Beta to post-GA to reduce scope risk for Wave 1.
2026-03-12 — Engineering proposal accepted: use region-based canaries + traffic shaping to validate runtime scaling. ENG to provide dashboard signals by 2026-03-18 (ENG-88101).
2026-03-13 — Release notes template finalized. PM to collate API change log and runtime upgrade notes; Design to supply screenshots for console features.
2026-03-14 — Security sign-off gated on completion of key rotation test in private deployment harness (ENG-90212). Security review flagged low risk; mitigation path documented.
next_steps: ENG: Deliver verification dashboards and test data by 2026-03-18 (ENG-88101)
PM: Publish finalized release-note drafts to /releases/changelog by 2026-03-22
Design: Provide final console screenshots and microcopy for changelog by 2026-03-20
Support: Draft KB article and customer FAQ for GA by 2026-04-10
risk_summary: Primary risks: (1) Performance/regression discovered during Beta causing delay to GA; (2) Cross-component documentation mismatch creating customer confusion on API contract; (3) Regional infra quota constraints delaying wave expansion. Mitigations: automated SLO checks, single-source-of-truth release notes, pre-allocated burst capacity for critical regions.
rollout_plan: Wave 0 — Internal Canary (2026-03-20): 2 internal customers + platform tests. Gate: 72h smoke, p95 latency < 120ms, error-rate < 0.2%.
Wave 1 — External Beta (2026-04-05): 5-10 customers opt-in. Gate: 7-day stability window, no critical regressions, cost delta < 10% on sampled workloads.
Wave 2 — GA (2026-04-20): Gradual ramp to 100% traffic with region-by-region enablement and automated rollback triggers at predefined thresholds.
release_notes_plan: Consolidate API diffs and runtime upgrade notes into single canonical changelog entry
Separate callouts: API contract changes, Console UX additions, Runtime performance improvements and known limitations
Add SDK migration snippet for any non-backwards-compatible behavior and link to GH examples
PM to run a review pass with Design & Eng on 2026-03-22 and publish draft
comm_plan: Internal: Launch briefing (All-Hands slides + TL;DR to Eng Slack) on 2026-04-18
External: Support KB + blog post + changelog entry coordinated for 2026-04-20
Customer calls: outreach to top 10 customers 1 week before GA to highlight changes and opt-in path for Beta
qa_checks: Automated E2E: SDK smoke + large-sequence generation under load
Performance: P95 latency and token throughput under representative load profile
Stability: 7-day error budget consumption check during Beta
Security: Key rotation and KMS integration test for Private deployments
Observability: Traces and token-level cost breakdowns validated and dashboarded
